title: Command 20 lb X-Large Picture Hanging Strips, 16 Pairs White Command Strips Heavy Duty Picture Hanger

reviews.title: They actually work really well!
reviews.body: I figured they would hold up pictures just fine, especially since these are the XL ones. I was more worried about my walls. I unstuck a frame from the wall thinking part of the paint would come with it, but nothing! Came off really cleanly and was still sticky when I put it back up. The photo hasn't fallen after being stuck to the wall again. I love these things!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 21, 2026
reviews.author: Ronke Sokunbi

reviews.title: Strong Hold Without Damaging Walls
reviews.body: I've used Command strips for years, and these extra-large versions are great for hanging larger frames and wall décor. They have a strong hold when applied correctly and help avoid putting unnecessary holes in the wall.I especially like that items can be removed later without leaving behind damage or sticky residue. The strips click together securely, making it easy to position and level frames during installation.Overall, these are a reliable option for renters or anyone who likes to switch up their wall décor without dealing with nails and patching holes.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 31, 2026
reviews.author: Paige

reviews.title: Best brand on the market
reviews.body: Best picture hanging strips on the market. I’m not sure what we did without them. Command is the only brand my husband will buy. So easy to use so convenient to use and very reliable.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 25, 2026
reviews.author: Karen L. Hurst

reviews.title: Great product!
reviews.body: These are really good and really strong. I use them to hang pictures. Very sticky and versatile. Worth the money. Does not leave any mark on the wall when you take them off.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 17, 2026
reviews.author: alli

reviews.title: Extremely strong adhesive - be careful on plaster walls.
reviews.body: I’ve been using command strips for more than 10 years and think they are a phenomenal product, but this is the first time I’ve used the XL.  These definitely hold up heavy weight items but be careful on removal.  I wanted to shift some paintings around and ended up pulling pieces of the plaster away from the wall when I tried to detach the painting from the wall - it happened twice in the kitchen and once in the hallway so I know it’s not a fluke.  I had to spackle, sand and paint which has never happened before from using command strips.  I’d recommend sticking with the large size if it will get your job done.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on October 5, 2025
reviews.author: Susanne S
